name: Troy Thompson
residence: Laramie County (official county biography: moved to the county with his family in 1981; married to Beth (McNamee) Thompson of Pine Bluffs)
occupation: Veterinarian and owner of Tri-State Veterinary Clinic; Laramie County commissioner (official county biography)
education: Seton Catholic High School, Cheyenne, 1989; Bachelor of Science in animal science, Cornell University, 1993; Doctor of Veterinary Medicine, Washington State University, 1997 (official county biography)
prior_offices: Laramie County commissioner since January 2010 (re-elected November 2026; the county's commissioners page lists him as vice chairman)
background: Troy Thompson is a Laramie County commissioner. His official county biography states that he was born in Greeley, Colorado, in 1971, moved to Laramie County with his family in 1981, graduated from Seton Catholic High School in Cheyenne in 1989, earned a Bachelor of Science in animal science from Cornell University in 1993 (where he was a Cornell National Scholar and Cornell Tradition Fellow and played football, including as a first-team All-Ivy League center), and received a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine from Washington State University in 1997. The biography states that he worked as an associate veterinarian at Avenues Pet Clinic, purchased Tri-State Veterinary Clinic in 1999, and has practiced veterinary medicine and operated that small business since, and that he has served as a Laramie County commissioner since January 2010. The county's commissioners page lists him as vice chairman. He won a new term in the November 3, 2026, general election.
